The '''Hidden Laboratory''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], it was used by [[Kur Ha'rangir]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] to perform experiments on [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]].<ref name="TOR:TG" />
